Standard: Covert landing lights conform to SAE ARP4392, Covertness paragraph under the Landing Lights section, SAE ARP5825, Covert Radiance Limits for Landing/Taxi Lights paragraph, and SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for the Landing/Taxi Covert Lights paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Test installed covert landing lights for conformance to SAE ARP4392, Covertness paragraph under the Landing Lights section, SAE ARP5825, Covert Radiance Limits for Landing/Taxi Lights paragraph, and SAE ARP5825, NRI Limits for the Landing/Taxi Covert Lights paragraph.
